info.name: WMS API
info.description: Requires the seed data in src/main/resources/data.sql (reloaded on every startup, ddl-auto: create). Every endpoint except /api/auth/** needs a JWT: the collection sends `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}`. Run the whole collection in order from a fresh start: the Auth folder runs first and ends with Login as admin, which saves `accessToken`. If you run a single request and `accessToken` is empty, the collection pre-request script logs in as admin / admin first. Create product saves `productId`, Create purchase order saves `purchaseOrderId`, and Soft delete - in use needs the stock added by the Purchase order flow.
